decision: 5 second time penalty. 1 penalty point (total of 1 penalty point for the 12 month period)
fact: The driver of Car 63 failed to maintain a 10 car-length distance behind the Safety Car.
offence: Breach of Article 55.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing and in-car video evidence. The evidence clearly showed that Car 63 was more than 125 metres, which is more than 20 car lengths, behind the car in front during the Safety Car period.
rules_referenced: Article 55.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 63 Failing To Maintain Distance Behind The Safety Car
to: The Team Manager, Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team
